How It Works

Four steps. You see it before you pay for it.

Every project runs the same way — simple, and you stay in control of the call at each step.

  1. 1

    Tell me your idea

    A short conversation about what you want built and who it’s for. That’s all I need to start.

  2. 2

    Free mockup first

    I design a first look at your site so you can see where it’s headed — before you pay anything.

  3. 3

    You approve it

    You say the word, and I build the real thing — then test it on a real phone so it works where your customers actually are.

  4. 4

    It goes live

    Your site or app goes up, and you get the link — ready to share with the world.

Business Site

For a business that needs the full presence.

  • Everything in Starter Site, plus:
